claim: At the mouth of her long stays on narrow tiles (3 turn starts or more, begun in raw rounds 101-200) our queen had a free wider neighbour tile in well under half of the cases, on main and on v31; an enemy head was within 3 columns and rows in about a quarter.
how_to_count: Games with our_code main (second slice v31), map_key with queen_spawn_dead_end false and not Portals #1. Narrow tile = two or fewer sides without kelp (a portal side is open; dragons ignored). A stay = a run of consecutive turn starts of a queen on narrow tiles; long = 3 turn starts or more; counted by the raw round of its first turn start (101 to 200). Mouth turn = the queen's last turn start before the stay (it is on a wider tile). At the mouth turn start: another way = at least one neighbour tile through an open side (portal partner tile included) that is not narrow and holds no body tile of any dragon, her own tail included. Enemy near = a head of the other side within 3 columns and 3 rows (wrapped) of her head. Report for our queen and for theirs, long stays and stays of 1 or 2 turn starts; and for long stays of any round that end in her death.
